title: tridens ambiguus
intro: Tridens ambiguus, commonly known as Fringed Three-Awn, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is native to North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Tridens ambiguus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
